secondary_analysis: J2 beta-binomial with Stage 3J-R remediated player bootstrap
primary_estimand: Conditional population-average association among observed measured player-seasons adjusted for barefoot height, original combine position and season; attempt-weighted through grouped denominator; time-invariant exposure identified between players.
development_replication_distinction: 2013-14 is development and excluded from primary; players may overlap. Out-of-season replication, not independent-player replication.
approved_core_conclusion: Greater residual wingspan was associated with lower free-throw accuracy in NBA players with available combine measurements. The negative association was observed in the 2013-14 development analysis and persisted in a 13-season replication panel excluding that season, with similar estimates across player-clustered, beta-binomial, first-season-only, player-balanced, attempt-threshold and leave-one-season-out analyses.
main_limitations: Measurement coverage is approximately 51%-67%. Combine participation, measurement availability/completeness, NBA survival, playing and shooting opportunity select the sample; the model does not correct this selection.

Free-throw attempt volume is the grouped-binomial denominator rather than a predictor. Low-FTA rates are overpredicted and rates in the 300+ FTA bin are underpredicted. The primary model is a working conditional association model, not a complete generative model of shooting opportunity.

Residual wingspan is time invariant and identified between players. Player-clustered uncertainty accounts for dependence, not unmeasured skill, training or role. Repeated outcomes do not provide within-player exposure identification or establish a causal mechanism.
Original combine position is an imperfect historical role proxy. Inference conditions on the frozen geometric reference; measurement and reference-fit uncertainty are not propagated.

descriptive_exposure_figure.reason: Only development-season exposure bins exist; replication bins or new player summaries would be new analysis. No new bins, raw unweighted FT-percent scatter, or fitted line is generated.

table1_position_policy: Use accounting player-season counts recovered arithmetically as frozen observed position FTA total / frozen observed position mean FTA from Stage3DR joint_PPC_metrics. No fitted or predictive fields used; round only after checking near-integer, require total 4117. Unique-player position distribution is not available as a frozen summary and is not invented.
table1_fta_policy: Use frozen observed overall FTA mean, SD and quartiles only; all accounting rows including zeros. No posterior predictions from failed models enter Table 1.
flow_policy: Use frozen approved 14-season coverage sum, full and primary panel counts. Combine eligibility and exact-ID linkage share one observed intersection count; do not invent sequential attrition counts.
